title: Isometric Incompatibility in Growing Elastic Sheets
summary: Geometric incompatibility, the inability of a material's rest state to be realized in Euclidean space, underlies shape formation in natural and synthetic thin sheets. Classical Gauss and Mainardi-Codazzi-Peterson (MCP) incompatibilities explain many patterns in nature, but they do not exhaust the mechanisms that frustrate thin elastic sheets. We identify a new incompatibility that forbids smooth stretching-free configurations, even when the rest state of the elastic sheet locally satisfies the Gauss and MCP compatibility conditions. We demonstrate this principle in a model of surface growth…
